bugsink/bugsink#165 (by vanschelven): Log `remote_addr` on the event
Add `remote_addr` as a field on the event, based on the client's IP address.

It should be captured at ingest-time and carried through to digest-time. Use the same metadata-passing mechanism we already use elsewhere.

We already rely on `SetRemoteAddrMiddleware` to ensure `request.REMOTE_ADDR` reflects the real client IP, even behind a proxy, so this value is usable in both the proxy/non-proxy case.

The field may be `None` for both backwards compatibility and misconfigured proxies (the middleware returns `None` for some such cases)
